convos.name: Carlos
lines: NPC: "I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
NPC: “That feast — real food, firelight. I still think about it.”
NPC: "The whole fire was arguing about Speedbump last night — what to even CALL it. 'The Ugly Beast' got shouted down. What's your vote?"
NPC: "I go back and forth. Ask me tomorrow, I'll say different."
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "I haven't eaten right in days. I can't pull my weight like this. Anything you can spare, I'll make it stretch."
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "Names are for when it's dead or known. Right now it's neither, so I retie every loose knot in passing instead."
NPC: "Alright — I should get back to it."
NPC: "Did you leave someone behind? ...Sorry. You don't have to answer that."

convos.name: Axel
lines: YOU: "What did you see out there?"
NPC: "This one — Spicebush. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
NPC: "Have you heard what they're calling Speedbump? Carlos is pushing 'Big Big'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
NPC: "Can I just — Good. Good to know I'm not the only one seeing it."
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "My stomach's been empty so long I've stopped feeling it, and that's worse. I need food before I can't work at all."
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I'm staying out of the naming fight. For now. Someone always gets precious about their pick."
NPC: "Give it three more days of arguing. Then someone says the obvious thing and we all pretend it was theirs."
NPC: "I listen to everyone and nod. It's a strategy. Probably."
NPC: "That's... pretty much all of it, honestly."
NPC: "Well." A breath. "That's where things stand."
NPC: "Rest when you can. We'll talk again soon."

convos.name: Giulia
lines: NPC: Giulia shows you where they go to think. "Don't tell the others. Everyone needs one place."
YOU: "I don't recognize the person in my head anymore. I think that's good? I don't know."
NPC: "The old you got you here. The new you keeps you here. Both count."
YOU: "What's new with you? Anything good, bad, or weird?"
NPC: "Huh. Let me think about that." "Have you heard what they're calling ducks in a row? Carlos is pushing 'Big Big'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."
NPC: "Yeah. Thought so — and I'm glad it's you saying it."
YOU: "About that question — we never finished."
NPC: "Huh. I wouldn't have guessed that about you."
NPC: They relax, a fraction. This is going well.
NPC: "Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
NPC: "I could talk all day, but — go on. We'll talk more."

convos.name: Hassan
lines: NPC: «यह सच है।» (you catch 'सच' — truth) They nod back, slowly.
NPC: «ठीक है।» (you catch 'ठीक' — okay) They nod back, slowly.
NPC: «बिल्कुल सही कहा।» (you catch 'सही' — right) They nod back, slowly.
NPC: «हाँ, हाँ, बिल्कुल।» (you catch 'हाँ' — yes) They nod back, slowly.
NPC: «हाँ, हाँ, बिल्कुल।» (you catch 'हाँ' — yes) They nod back, slowly.
NPC: They glance toward their own thoughts; the exchange is winding down.

notes: staged gut-rot outbreak on 5 adults at d15; downstream (ticks/tending/relief/convo) fully real
